title: Projects
intro: Some work I've designed, developed, and lovingly overthought. A mix of deep-dive long term projects and case studies and smaller projects. Not all my work is live, some products are no longer on the web. I've shared the best available examples and case studies.

items.name: Silhouette Exchange
items.description: Silhouette Exchange is a sheilded exchange platform on the Hyperliquid blockchain. I work closely with the designer and review frontend code. I was responsible for making the site pixel perfect and implementing the design to perfection.

items.name: Time Coupons
items.description: I was one of two developers who built this project. Time saw great initail sucess after it's launch. Personally, it was a dream brand to work on. The site is not currently live after changes in the SEO industry by Google in 2024. Wayback Machine is provided, refresh on load to (hopefully) interact with the site

items.name: Seeder De Boer
